action_summary: Restore the retained four-fold exp320 PET inference configuration associated with v129 (0.82845), replacing the active small separated model (v136: 0.80526). Restore its precise ordinal cutpoints together with its large backbone and vocabulary override; preserve PET tokenization, output scaling, equal fold averaging and validation length. Make the active invocation fail on subprocess errors, load checkpoint tensors through CPU while keeping strict parameter matching, and explicitly join PET predictions to submission essay IDs with schema checks. No new threshold fitting or speculative blending is introduced without matching held-out predictions. Historical performance gives a credible improvement path, but the new leaderboard score cannot be measured without data.
